findings.test: test/site-build.test.js: no page renders markup from catalog data
findings.title: Stored XSS: LLM-sourced `replaces` rendered unescaped in the home page FAQ
findings.description: The home FAQ answer joined the top `replaces` values into HTML without esc(). `replaces` is free text produced by the LLM classifier from third-party README content (validated only as a string of at most 60 chars). appDetail() also put the repo name into an href unescaped.
findings.impact: A README written to steer the classifier (prompt injection) could, once its app ranked near the top, run script on openflarestack.com for every visitor: defacement, redirecting Deploy buttons, or phishing.
findings.remediation: Escape both sinks with esc(). Added a whole-site test that builds from a hostile catalog and fails on any raw markup in any page.

findings.test: test/site-build.test.js: every response carries the security headers
findings.title: No anti-framing, HSTS or Permissions-Policy headers
findings.description: _headers set only nosniff and Referrer-Policy. Pages could be framed by any site and there was no HSTS.
findings.impact: Clickjacking of the Deploy / Submit buttons from a hostile page; no browser-enforced HTTPS on repeat visits.
findings.remediation: Added X-Frame-Options: DENY, CSP frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none', HSTS (1 year, no includeSubDomains) and a Permissions-Policy. script-src deliberately not set (see recommendations).

findings.title: Render-blocking stylesheet delayed first paint (Core Web Vitals)
findings.description: styles.css (43 KB, 9.8 KB gzip) was the only request between the HTML and first paint. Lighthouse estimated 380-600 ms on mobile.
findings.impact: Slower FCP/LCP on first visits from search, which is how most visitors arrive.
findings.remediation: Minify (scripts/lib/minify-css.js) and inline the stylesheet. CSSOM equivalence verified (438/438 rules), 16 screenshots byte-identical. Mobile FCP median of 5: 1503->1257 ms home, 1354->1257 ms app page, 1381->1253 ms category.

findings.test: test/seo.test.js; test/site-build.test.js: titles and descriptions fit
findings.title: Meta descriptions over 160 characters on 271 of 427 pages
findings.description: Category, alternatives, app and home descriptions ran to 279 characters and were cut mid-word in results.
findings.impact: Weaker snippets in Google/Bing and AI search citations.
findings.remediation: clipText() in layout() for meta/og/twitter descriptions (sentence end, else word boundary + ellipsis); shorter category meta leading with count and products. Visible text unchanged.

findings.title: Titles over 65 characters on 369 pages, mostly from the brand suffix
findings.description: Every title got ' | OpenFlareStack', pushing most app and alternatives titles past what results show.
findings.remediation: pageTitle() adds the brand only when the result is 65 characters or less. 64 content titles remain long because of long product names; search engines shorten those without losing the leading keywords.

findings.title: og:description / twitter:description too long on category pages
findings.description: check_social_meta.py warned that category og:description exceeded ~160 characters.
findings.impact: Previews on X, LinkedIn, Slack cut off the text.
findings.remediation: Same clipText() as SEO-002 applied to og:description and twitter:description.

findings.title: No AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md
findings.description: No agent instructions existed, so agent-written code had no record of the escaping, performance or merge rules.
findings.impact: Future changes could reintroduce SEC-001-style sinks or a render-blocking stylesheet.
findings.remediation: Added AGENTS.md (single source of truth) and CLAUDE.md importing it.

findings.title: No .env.example although the code reads 17 environment variables
findings.description: Only some variables were in the README Setup table; LLM_CONCURRENCY, LLM_MIN_INTERVAL_MS, AWESOME_DIR, README_DUMP and the new build variables were undocumented.
findings.impact: Harder local setup; settings discovered only by reading code.
findings.remediation: Added .env.example with every variable, defaults and no secret values.

findings.title: README claimed no third-party requests, but the site loads PilotFox analytics
findings.description: Commit 4f37265 added a PilotFox analytics script; the README still said every file comes from our own domain with no third-party requests.
findings.impact: Inaccurate privacy/performance claim for readers and contributors.
findings.remediation: README now names the one third-party request and how it loads.
